title.zh: CoQ 国际象棋·围棋棋钟

description.en: The whole half-screen is the button. Fischer increment, Bronstein delay, byoyomi and sudden death — built for a phone lying flat between two players, and it keeps running offline.
description.zh: 整块半屏就是按钮：Fischer 加秒、Bronstein 延时、读秒与包干四种模式。手机平放在两位棋手之间就能开一局，断网也照常走。

imageAlt.en: The clock mid-game in facing mode
imageAlt.zh: 对局中的棋钟（对坐模式）

description.en: Load any SGF and walk its variations on a 13×13 board. Red lines mark what White surrounds, blue lines what Black does, and arrows point at the moves worth talking about — the markup I use when teaching beginners. The browser build runs offline; the desktop app adds GTP engines and native dialogs.
description.zh: 读入任意 SGF，在 13×13 棋盘上逐手浏览变化。红线标出白棋围住的地方、蓝线标出黑棋的，箭头指向值得讲的那几手——教初学者时我就这样摆。浏览器版可离线使用，桌面版另有 GTP 引擎与原生文件对话框。

imageAlt.en: A finished 13×13 game in MultiGo Neo: red lines around White's territory, blue lines around Black's, and arrows on the key points
imageAlt.zh: MultiGo Neo 里的一局 13 路实战：红线是白棋围住的区域，蓝线是黑棋围住的区域，箭头指向关键处

description.en: My study fork of Sabaki, the SGF editor: scoring that follows the record's rules, a real portable mode, and the board I already know. Desktop only — download the Windows build, unpack it, connect your own engines. Unstable; upstream Sabaki is the safer choice.
description.zh: Sabaki 的个人学习分支：按棋谱规则判断胜负、真正的便携模式，还有我最熟悉的棋盘。只有桌面版——下载 Windows 包，解压即用，再连上自己的引擎。分支不稳定，求稳请用上游 Sabaki。

imageAlt.en: my-Sabaki showing a finished professional game, with the result in the side panel
imageAlt.zh: my-Sabaki 打开一局已结束的职业对局，右侧显示对局结果
